kundaliExplainer.title: What is a Kundali?
kundaliExplainer.subtitle: The ancient blueprint of your life, written in the stars at the moment you took your first breath.
kundaliExplainer.h1: The Janam Kundali — Your Cosmic Birth Certificate
kundaliExplainer.h3: How to Read Your Free Kundali Online
kundaliExplainer.cta: Generate your free Vedic Kundali in 60 seconds →
kundaliExplainer.p1: A Kundali — also known as Janam Kundali, Janam Patrika, or simply a Vedic birth chart — is a precise astronomical map of where the Sun, Moon, and the seven visible planets stood at the exact moment of your birth. Drawn as a square or wheel divided into 12 houses and overlaid against 27 nakshatras (lunar mansions), it is the foundation of Jyotish, the 5,000-year-old science of light from the Vedas.
kundaliExplainer.p2: Every Kundali is unique. Even twins born minutes apart can carry meaningfully different charts, because the rising sign — the Lagna — shifts roughly every two hours, reshaping the entire pattern of houses, planetary lords, and life themes.
kundaliExplainer.p3: The most important difference: a Vedic Kundali uses the sidereal zodiac with the Lahiri Ayanamsa, anchored to the actual stars in the sky. Western astrology uses the tropical zodiac fixed to the Earth's seasons. Over the centuries the two have drifted nearly 24 degrees apart — which means your "Vedic Sun sign" is often one full sign earlier than your Western Sun sign, and the timing of every transit is calculated against real celestial geometry.
kundaliExplainer.p4: Vedic astrology also leans on your Moon sign (Rashi) rather than your Sun sign, because the Moon governs mind, emotion, and the rhythm of daily life. And it adds something Western astrology lacks entirely: Dasha periods — the Vimshottari system of planetary cycles that tells you when a theme in your chart will activate, often down to the month.
kundaliExplainer.p5: To generate an accurate Kundali you need three things: your date of birth, your exact time of birth (ideally from your birth certificate — even a 10-minute error can shift the Lagna), and your birth city. Once your chart is cast, look first at four pillars:
kundaliExplainer.li1: Lagna (Ascendant): the sign rising on the eastern horizon at your birth — your outer self and life direction.
kundaliExplainer.li2: Rashi (Moon sign): your emotional nature and the foundation of all Vedic predictions.
kundaliExplainer.li3: Nakshatra: the lunar mansion your Moon sits in — the deepest layer of personality and karma.
kundaliExplainer.li4: Maha Dasha: the planetary period currently shaping your life's chapter.
kundaliExplainer.p6: Most online kundali generators stop at a chart image. We go further: every Kundali is interpreted by a three-layer engine that combines precise astronomical math (Swiss Ephemeris with Lahiri Ayanamsa), classical Jyotish rules from texts like Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, and a carefully tuned AI that speaks in the voice of a warm elder — never fatalistic, always empowering. You'll see your houses, planets, dashas, yogas, dosha analysis, and daily guidance, all woven into one coherent reading.
